exposure: Antibiotic use in the first year of life
cohort: All children born in Denmark from 1995 to 2009 (979,039 children)
finding: Antibiotic use in the first year of life is associated with a modestly increased risk for Crohn's disease, with the highest risk observed in children receiving 6 or more courses of antibiotics.
mod_finding: The study adjusted for route of delivery as a potential confounder when assessing the association between antibiotic use and Crohn disease risk.
